note: Source manifest for the ORCH-753 gold cohort. The paper text is NOT committed; it lives at C:/t/eval-fulltext/<PMCID>.txt and gold.load_fulltext refuses a text whose sha256 differs.
citation: Chakraborty A et al. The transcription factor Rlm1 couples the MAPK Slt2/ERK1 pathway to the IRE1-driven unfolded protein response Communications biology 2026.
pathway_in_one_line: In yeast ER stress, the cell-wall-integrity MAPK Slt2 is activated independently of IRE1 and acts through the transcription factor Rlm1 to feed into the IRE1/Hac1 unfolded protein response.
scope_note: In scope: the Bck1 -> Mkk1/Mkk2 -> Slt2 three-tier cascade, activation-loop phosphorylation of Slt2 at T190/Y192 under DTT and tunicamycin, IRE1 autophosphorylation at S841/T844, HAC1 mRNA splicing and Hac1 protein accumulation, Rlm1 acting downstream of Slt2, and the negative genetic interaction between the slt2 and ire1 pathways. Adjacent and voluminous: the Introduction restates the generic mammalian MAP3K -> MAP2K -> MAPK architecture with named pairs (Raf -> MEK1/2 -> ERK1/2, MEKK2/3 -> MEK5 -> BMK1, MKK4/7 -> JNK, MKK3/6 -> p38) and the three UPR sensors IRE1/PERK/ATF6. Those are not this organism and not measured here; a drafter that books them inflates the pathway with textbook mammalian signalling.
selected_because: Fills signalling x fungal with a positive-result paper (about 105 interaction-bearing sentences) in which the measured cascade is short and ordered, so interaction recall is checkable. Deliberately chosen over PMC12691644 (Candida albicans Efg1 / protein kinase A, 45,797 chars), which is a well-executed NEGATIVE-result paper: its gold would be almost entirely refuted claims, which is interesting but a poor first drafting target. The large mammalian-signalling preamble is the known hazard and is the reason this is one of the two picks I am least confident about.
